limitations: Synthetic documents; no real personal-document human review.
One sequential run per version; caching, sampling and upstream load are uncontrolled.
Comparable metrics use six initial questions; balance deltas cover the entire run, including an extra followup in new-version runs.
Per-task budget is 30000; the final dates case hit this limit during report review. EXE default-budget verification is recorded separately.
Pipeline quality labels and support verdicts are not human correctness scores.
Account balance deltas may include concurrent activity and still require billing-detail reconciliation.
